inventory_reservations_target_check.name: inventory_reservations_target_check
inventory_reservations_target_check.value: "inventory_reservations"."order_id" is not null or "inventory_reservations"."cart_id" is not null

carts_owner_check.name: carts_owner_check
carts_owner_check.value: "carts"."user_id" is not null or "carts"."anonymous_token" is not null

shipments_delivered_after_shipped_check.name: shipments_delivered_after_shipped_check
shipments_delivered_after_shipped_check.value: "shipments"."delivered_at" is null or ("shipments"."shipped_at" is not null and "shipments"."delivered_at" >= "shipments"."shipped_at")

banners_window_check.name: banners_window_check
banners_window_check.value: "banners"."ends_at" is null or "banners"."starts_at" is null or "banners"."ends_at" > "banners"."starts_at"

homepage_sections_window_check.name: homepage_sections_window_check
homepage_sections_window_check.value: "homepage_sections"."ends_at" is null or "homepage_sections"."starts_at" is null or "homepage_sections"."ends_at" > "homepage_sections"."starts_at"
